name: BHM
title: BHM — Bachelor of Hotel Management
intro: The hospitality roadmap: NCHM JEE, four years at an IHM or hotel school, industrial training and hotel careers.

phases.title: Class 11–12 prerequisites
phases.summary: Any stream with English; communication skills matter.
points: BHM is open to Class 12 pass students from any stream, with English as a subject.
Build communication, grooming, food interest and customer-service skills.
Check the age and marks requirements in the NCHM JEE bulletin.
Visit a hotel or a hospitality fair to understand the work.

phases.title: NCHM JEE and counselling
phases.summary: The national entrance for Institutes of Hotel Management and other participating colleges.
points: NCHM JEE is conducted by the NTA and tests numerical ability, reasoning, general knowledge, English and service aptitude.
Counselling follows rank and chooses an Institute of Hotel Management or an approved college.
Private hotel schools run their own tests or admit on merit.
Check the colleges’ affiliation and placement record.

phases.title: Academic years
phases.summary: Food production, food and beverage service, front office and housekeeping.
points: Year 1: Food Production, Food and Beverage Service, Front Office and Accommodation Operations.
Year 2: Advanced operations, Food Science, Hotel Accounting and Hospitality Law.
Year 3–4: Management subjects such as Marketing, HR, Revenue Management and Event Management.
Practical sessions in kitchens, restaurants and labs are a large part of the course.

phases.title: Industrial exposure training
phases.summary: A paid placement of several months in hotels or restaurants.
points: The industrial exposure training is a fixed period (about four to five months) in a partner hotel.
You rotate through departments and are assessed by supervisors.
Learn real service standards, teamwork and guest handling.
Many students receive job offers from training hotels.

phases.title: Careers and higher study
phases.summary: Hotels, airlines, cruise lines, catering and entrepreneurship.
points: Entry roles: management trainee, front office executive, F&B executive, chef de partie and housekeeping supervisor.
Other industries: airlines, cruise ships, hospital hospitality, event management and restaurants.
Further study: MBA in hospitality, MHM or international programmes.
Entrepreneurship in cafes, catering and boutique hotels.
